_comment: Shared generated aggregates that a branch must never edit directly (tools/scripts/hotspot_edit_guard.py). Each was a top merge-conflict hotspot and now lives as one fragment per entry; a branch writes the fragment through `writer`, never the aggregate. Register a hotspot here only once its fragments exist, or every legitimate edit would be refused.

hotspots.why: 75 non-merge commits on main in one week, and the most conflicted file in the repository: every pull request that added or re-pointed a script test rewrote neighbouring lines of one generated document
